items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: No, his name was Stomp King. ... Davis was his -- James Davis was his name, but he called himself Stomp King and he stuttered, and he was a nervous wreck and this type of -- but he -- things were just so pathetic at that time, because there was no work.

ctx.x: And he was called the Stump?
No, his name was Stomp King.
